title: Setup Transitions + Predictive Failure + Force Capability
description: Build SetupTransitionEngine (flip/re-fixture verification, datum chain tolerance stack, pallet layout collision), PredictiveFailureEngine (Monte Carlo success probability, sensitivity analysis, risk maps), and ForceCapabilityEngine (machine power/torque limits, cumulative thermal growth, tool wear force impact).

units.title: SetupTransitionEngine: flip feasibility, datum chain, pallet collision, fixture changeover
steps: Verify parallel datum surfaces exist for each flip orientation
Tolerance stack through datum chain: RSS + Monte Carlo (reuse MultiSetupPlanner logic)
Pallet/tombstone layout: check for part-to-part and part-to-fixture collision
Clamping strategy suggestion per setup based on available surfaces
Wire WorkholdingViabilityEngine for per-setup clamping verification
exit_conditions: Pallet collision detected for overlapping layouts

units.title: PredictiveFailureEngine: Monte Carlo risk assessment, sensitivity analysis, risk maps
steps: Material property variation (±8%) → force distribution → deflection → tolerance compliance
Tool wear uncertainty → remaining life probability (Weibull distribution)
Combined P(success) = product of per-operation probabilities
Sensitivity: which parameter variation kills feasibility first?
Risk map: color-code operations by failure probability
exit_conditions: Risk map correctly ranks operations by danger

units.title: ForceCapabilityEngine: machine limits, thermal growth, tool wear force impact
steps: Machine force/power/torque check: Fc vs F_max, P vs P_max, T vs T_max from machine catalog
Cumulative thermal growth: α × ΔT × L accumulates through program
Tool wear → force increase: worn tool requires more force (Taylor + Takeyama-Murata)
Flag operations where force exceeds 80% of machine capacity (warning) or 100% (critical)
